                ABOUT THE COLLEGE :
                Kamargaon College, established in 1972, is situated at
                Kamargaon under Bokakhat Sub-Division of Golaghat District of
                Assam at a distance of 400 mtrs. towards north from NH 37. It is
                a distinct institute of higher learning of Kamargaon which covers
                an area of 35 villages having around 75,000 population.
                Kamargaon College had been a great need of the people of the
                locality since years back for imparting higher education to the
                young aspirants who cannot go outside for education owing to
                their poor economic background. In 1971 some enlightened
                persons came forward to establish a college at Kamargaon
                considering the need of the community. People of the locality joined
                hands with them and Kamargaon College came into existence in
                July, 1972. Since then, the College has been serving for the noble
                cause of re-shaping and transforming this socio economically
                dis-advantaged society through quality education. The College
                endeavours to promote in the students and teachers an awareness
                and understanding of the social needs of the locality and prepare
                them for fulfilling such needs.
                Kamargaon College is affiliated to Dibrugarh University and
                included in the list of the institution under section 2 (f) and 12 (b)
                of the UGC Act. and accredited for the first time by NAAC in 2004
                with C++ and re-accredited in 2011 with ‘B’ grade, with 'B+' grade
                in 2019 & B++ in 2025.
                VISION AND GOAL :
                Kamargaon College was established with a vision to make it a
                nourishing ground of the young minds. The goal of the college is
                to provide higher education to the young aspirants most of whom
                belong to socio-economically disadvantaged sections and to
                identify the needs and problems of the locality and to guide them
                towards upliftment.

                PROGRAMMES OF STUDY :
                Four year under graduate programs (FYUGP) in choice based
                credit system (CBCS)
                This course shall be called the Four Year Undergraduate
                Programmes (FYUGP) in Choice Based Credit System (CBCS),
                2023. These course shall be effective for the Courses of Study
                leading to a UG Certificate, UG Diploma, Three Year UG Degree,
                Four Year UG Degree (Honours) and Four Year UG Degree
                (Honours with Research).
                Undergraduate Programmes: Undergraduate programmes will
                include the following
                (i)   UG Certificate programme : UG Certificate Programme
                      leads to a UG certificate after completing 1 year (2
                      semesters) of study in the chosen fields of study. Students
                      on exit shall be awarded UG certificate (in the Field of Study/
                      Discipline) after securing the requisite 44 Credits on
                      completion of Semester II if, in addition, they complete one
                      work based/skill based vocational course/internship of 4
                      credits within one year from the completion of 2nd semester
                      examination. These students are allowed to re-enter the
                      degree programme within a period of three years and
                      complete the degree within the stipulated maximum period
                      of seven years.
                (ii) UG Diploma Programme : UG Diploma Programme leads
                     to a UG diploma after 2 years (4 semesters) of study in the
                     chosen fields of study. Students on exit shall be awarded
                     UG Diploma (in the Field of Study/Discipline) after securing
                     the requisite 88 Credits on completion of Semester IV if, in
                     addition, they complete one work based/skill based vocational
                     course/internship of 4 credits within one year from the
                     completion of 4th semester examination. These students are
                     allowed to re-enter the degree programme within a period of

                                        |2|
 Prospectus
      2025-26

                     three years and complete the degree within the maximum
                     period of seven years.
                (iii) Three Year UG Degree Programme (BA, B. Sc, B. Com
                      and Bachelors in other disciplines) with single/double major:
                      Students who wish to undergo a 3-year (6 semester) UG
                      programme shall be awarded UG degree in the Major
                      discipline after successful completion of three years,
                      securing a minimum of 132 credits. Provision of double Major
                      shall be implemented in due course of time.
                (iv) Four Year UG Programme with honours (BA, B. Sc, B.
                     Com and Bachelors in other disciplines) with single/double
                     major: Students who wish to undergo a 4-year (8 semester)
                     UG programme shall be awarded UG Honours degree in the
                     Major discipline after successful completion of four years,
                     securing a minimum of 176 credits. Provision of double Major
                     shall be implemented in due course of time.
                (v) Four Year UG Programme with honours with Research
                    (BA, B. Sc, B. Com and Bachelors in other disciplines) with
                    single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a 4-year
                    (8 semester) UG programme shall be awarded UG Honours
                    and research degree in the Major discipline after successful
                    completion of four years with a rigorous research project,
                    securing a minimum of 176 credits. Provision of double Major
                    shall be implemented in due course of time.
                Minimum eligibility criteria for multiple entry points of the UG
                programmes
                a.   1st year : Senior Secondary School Leaving Certificate or
                     Higher Secondary (Class 12) Certificate obtained after
                     successful completion of Grade 12 or equivalent stage of
                     education and/or Admission test conducted by College/
                     University/National Level Testing Agency/State Level Testing
                     Agency.

                b.   2nd year: A certificate obtained after successful completion
                     of 1 year (2 semesters) of the undergraduate programme.
                     These students are to take admission in the 2nd year within
                     a period of three years from obtaining the UG certificate from
                     Dibrugarh University or any other University/institution
                     recognized by Dibrugarh University.
                c.   3rd year: A diploma obtained after successful completion of
                     2 years (4 semesters) of the undergraduate programme.
                     These students are to take admission in the 3rd year UG
                     programme within a period of three years from obtaining the
                     UG diploma from Dibrugarh University or any other University/
                     institution recognized by Dibrugarh University.
                d.   4th Year (Honours): A Bachelor’s degree after successful
                     completion of three years (6 semesters) of the Undergraduate
                     programme obtained from Dibrugarh University or any other
                     University/institution recognized by Dibrugarh University.
                     These students are to complete the degree within the
                     stipulated maximum period of seven years.
                e.   4th Year (Honours with Research): A three year Bachelor
                     Degree with a minimum of 7.5 CGPA. The minimum entry
                     requirement for 4th year (Honours/Research) UG programme
                     within a period of three years from obtaining 3 year Bachelor
                     Degree from Dibrugarh University or any other University/
                     institution recognized by Dibrugarh University. These
                     students are to complete the degree within the stipulated
                     maximum period of seven years.
                Statutory reservation policy of the government shall be followed
                in case of selection of eligible candidates for admission.

                GRADING SYSTEM
                The absolute grading system shall be applied in evaluating
                performance of the students.
                The following scale of grading system shall be applied to indicate
                the performances of students in terms of letter grade and grade
                Letter Grade with meaning        Grade Point
                    O       Outstanding         10 (Marks securing 90% and above)
                   A+         Excellent            9 (Marks securing 80%-90%)
                    A        Very Good            8 (Marks securing 70% -80%)
                   B+           Good              7 (Marks securing 60% -70%)
                    B      Above Average          6 (Marks securing 50% -60%)
                    C         Average             5 (Marks securing 40%- 50%)
                    P           Pass               4 (Marks securing 30%-40%)
                    F            Fail                             0
                    Ab        (absent)                            0
                ATTENDANCE
                A student who has less than 80% attendance in average shall not
                be permitted to sit for the End-semester examination. However,
                that it shall be open to the University to grant exemption to a student
                who has attended a minimum of 70% classes but failed to obtain
                the prescribed 80% attendance for valid reasons, on
                recommendation of the Head/Chairperson/ Principals of the
                Department/Centre/College on payment of a prescribed fee(s).

                The Head of the Departments/Chairperson of the Centre for
                Studies/Principals of the Colleges shall announce the names of
                all students who shall not be eligible to take the Endsemester
                examinations in the various Programmes and send a copy of the

                same to the Controller of Examinations. Such candidates shall
                have to repeat the concerned Course(s) when it is offered next.

                A student declared as dis-collegiate shall not be allowed to
                proceed to the next higher semester. He/she shall need to pursue
                the semester afresh in which he/she was declared as dis-
                collegiate along with the next fresh batch.

                STUDENTS’ AID FUND :
                The college has instituted “Students’ Aid Fund” out of the
                contributions from the students of the college. The objectives of
                the fund are :
                    1. To render financial assistance to the poor and deserving
                       students for payment of tution fees, examination fees,
                       purchase of text books, stationery etc.
                    2. To meet any needs of the students considered to be
                       genuine by the students’ welfare committee of the college.
                SCHOLARSHIPS AND AWARDS :
                    1. State Merit Scholarship :
                        Meritorious students who come in the merit list of H.S.L.C.
                        & H. S. examination can apply for this scholarship.
                    2. Scholarship for students belonging to such catagories as
                       Schedule Caste (S.C.), Schedule Tribe (S.T.), Tea Garden
                       Labour (T.G.L.) & Other Backward Caste (O.B.C.)
                       categories can apply for this scholarship.
                    3. Award from the departments to meritorious degree
                       (Honours) students.
                    4. Best Reader Award to students by the College library.

                MOHINI RAJKUMARI GIRLS' HOSTEL :
                The college has a well maintained Girls’ Hostel (limited seat).
                STUDENTS’ COUNSELLING AND GUIDANCE CELL :
                The college has a Students Counseling and Guidance Cell to
                provide information and guidance to the students regarding
                employment and higher education.
                GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL CELL :
                A Grievance Redressal cell has been formed to meet the
                grievances of the students and the employees, if any.
                ANTI-RAGGING CELL :
                The college has a strong Anti-Ragging cell to curb the menace of
                ragging inside the college campus. Legal penalties will be imposed
                on the defaulters.
                WOMEN’S STUDY CELL :
                The college has a Women’s Study Cell affiliated to Women’s
                Study Centre, D. U. & ACTA. This cell works for the all-round
                development of the girls student and the women community of
                the area in general.
                GAMES AND SPORTS :
                The college is aware of the importance of physical activities for
                the students which should be combined with his / her academic
                pursuits. The college provides the basic facilities for such activities
                in terms of fields, courts, playing equipments both for practice

                Kho-Kho. All the above games are available to students at all
                playing times. Annual competition in all the above said games are
                conducted by Students’ Union of the college during the college
                week.
                GYM CENTRE :
                Well equipped gym centre is also there in the college campus for
                students.
                LITERARY & CULTURAL ACTIVITIES :
                Cultural and literary activities among the student community in
                the campus are promoted through various platforms namely
                Debating and Literary Club, Drama & Music Club etc. Each platform
                functions under the supervision of the respective teacher-in-charge.
                LANGUAGE LABORATORY :
                There is a language lab for enhancement of language, linguistic
                and phonetic skills.
                COMPUPER LABORATORY :
                Well equipped computer laboratory there in the college.
                EXTENSION ACTIVITIES :
                The college makes a continuous effort to bring in “community
                orientation” in its activities. Accordingly the college has been
                organising various community oriented programmes such as
                health and environment awareness programme, agro-based
                training programme, health and other relief camps for the flood
                victims of the area etc. Moreover, the college has been rendering
                various social services to the nearby villages from time to time.

                NATIONAL SERVICE SCHEME :
                The college also has an active National Service Scheme
                Unit. Students are engaged in various social works under
                the leadership of teachers.
                SCOUT AND GUIDE :
                An unit of Scout and Guide has been formed in the college
                from the academic session 2003-2004 in order to generate
                Scout and Guide movement among the students.
                STUDENTS’ UNION :
                The college has instituted a students’ body known as
                ‘Kamargaon College Students’ Union Society” (KCSU).
                The members are elected in students general election
                held annually.
                ALUMNI ASSOCIATION :
                To establish a network between the college and its alumni,
                “Kamargaon College Alumni Association” was constituted.
                Through this platform the Alumni can get an opportunity
                to get involved in the development activities of the college.
                COLLEGE HEALTH CENTRE :
                In association with Kamargaon Public Health Centre, the
                college has set up a first aid cell to render first aid service
                to the students. In addition the college organises health
                camps in the interest of the public off and on.
                CANTEEN :
                The college has a well maintained hygienic canteen for
                the light refreshment of the students, teachers and
                employees.

                   UNIVERSITY GRANTS COMMISSION
Steps taken by UGC to prevent ragging in Educational Institutions.
   1.   In January, 2000, UGC circulated the guidelines prepared by UGC Expert
        Committee on curbing the menance of ragging to all Universities for taking
        necessary action.
   2.   In July, 2007 UGC again wrote to all Universities sending the Dr. Raghavan
        Committee Report (Committee constituted by M/HRD on the orders of
        Supreme Court) on measures of prevention of ragging in educational
        institutions for strict compliance. The reports are available on UGC
        Website www.ugc.ac.in
   3.   As per the Raghavan Committee report the Universities are to set up :
        i)     Anti ragging Squads.
        ii)    Anti ragging committees.
        iii)   Mention in the prospectus about the possible action against ragging.
        iv)    Publicize the name/telephone no. and address of the authorities to
               be contacted.
        v)     Counseling of seniors and freshers.
        vi)    Conduct orientation courses for freshers.
        vii) Report about the action taken by the anti-ragging squads and anti-
             ragging committee to UGC.
        viii) No. of cases of ragging are to be mentioned in the prospectus along
              with the punishment given to the guilty.
        ix)    Erect suitable hoardings/bill boards banners in prominent places
               within the campus.
   4.   The UGC has requested for information/feedback from the Universities
        on the steps taken for curbing ragging in the prescribed proforma.
   5.   The Universities have been instructed to mention in every prospectus if
        any incident of ragging comes to the notice of the authority the concerned
        student shall be given liberty to explain and if his explanation is not found
        satisfactory the authority would expel him from the institutions.
   6.   The Commission has created a cell for dealing with ragging in educational
        institution.
